lines.arrive: A hilltop, in the fog. Five of you, and none of you knows who you are.
lines.veil: When the veil lifts, you'll each be born into the town that's chosen here. Rich or poor, lucky or not. You won't know which until then.
lines.towns: On the table, three towns. The numbers are what each house will have.
lines.town_1: In the first town, everyone has the same. Five each.
lines.town_2: In the second, most have very little, and one has a fortune. On average, it's the richest town of the three.
lines.town_3: In the third, some have more than others. But even the least well off have more than anyone in the first town.
lines.ask: Which town will you choose, not knowing who you'll be?
lines.others_chose: You don't choose. So the others do. And the veil lifts.
lines.eq_1: Everyone has the same. So do you.
lines.eq_2: Nobody was left with less. Nobody could have more, either.
lines.g_mid: A good house. Not the best, but better than most.
lines.g_poor: One of the small houses. It was always the likeliest place to land.
lines.g_2: On average, this was the richest town. But nobody lives an average life.
lines.r_low: One of the smallest houses. Still more than anyone has in the first town.
lines.r_mid: Not the biggest house, and not the smallest.
lines.r_2: You chose the town where the worst place to land was as good as it could be.
